target.title: Fix serve deadline leaving orphan in-flight work
target.body:
## Summary

Addresses ClawSweeper / Codex review feedback on #2007 while keeping the documented `--request-timeout` contract.

When serve hit its request deadline, the old code returned 504 immediately but cleared the cache in-flight flag while canceled provider work kept running. A later refresh could start a second fetch on top of the first.

This revision:
- **Returns 504 immediately** on timeout (no drain of canceled work before the response).
- **Keeps the cache key in-flight** until cleanup grace elapses, so a second fetch cannot stack on the same key.
- **Releases retained keys after grace without awaiting uncooperative work** (cleanup races `work.value` via `BoundedTaskJoin` and cancels on timeout).
- **Bounds queued same-key waits** to each request's own clamped `--request-timeout`.
- **Registers same-key waiters synchronously** before racing cleanup release.
- **Elects one waiter** to restart a fetch after cleanup; remaining waiters stay queued until that fetch completes.

Does not claim to close #1999 without the maintainer-requested Jetsam/process diagnostics.

## Codex / ClawSweeper follow-up (`d1bf50c2` + `8773f2da`)

- Clamp oversized finite `--request-timeout` before queued-wait conversion.
- Enqueue same-key waiters on the actor turn before timeout race.
- Release retained keys early when canceled work exits cooperatively.
- Added focused coverage in `CLIServeTimeoutTests`.

## Behavior proof (local, 2026-07-10)

### Unit tests

```
swift test --filter CLIServeRouterTests
✔ Test run with 48 tests in 1 suite passed

swift test --filter CLIServeTimeoutTests
✔ Test run with 4 tests in 1 suite passed
```

### Live `codexbar serve` transcript (redacted local config)

```bash
$ CodexBarCLI serve --port 18777 --request-timeout 2 --refresh-interval 60
CodexBar server listening on http://127.0.0.1:18777

$ curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:18777/usage" --max-time 15
[{"provider":"codex","error":{"kind":"provider","message":"codex usage timed out",...}, ...]
HTTP 200 time_total=1.646184s
wall_clock≈1.73s

$ curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:18777/usage" --max-time 15
[... provider timeout rows ...]
HTTP 200 time_total=1.628925s

$ curl -s -w "\nHTTP %{http_code} time_total=%{time_total}s\n" \
    "http://127.0.0.1:18777/health" --max-time 3
{"status":"ok"}
HTTP 200 time_total=0.000843s
```

With `--request-timeout 2`, `/usage` returns in ~1.6s (provider-level timeout rows) instead of hanging; a second same-key request also stays bounded (~1.6s). Health remains sub-millisecond.

Note: live proof still shows provider-level timeout rows rather than the outer 504 cleanup path; unit tests cover the retain/release behavior.

Latest commits: `8773f2da`.

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter CLIServeRouterTests` (48 tests)
- [x] `swift test --filter CLIServeTimeoutTests` (4 tests)
- [x] `cleanup grace releases retained key while uncooperative work still runs`
- [x] `queued serve request times out during retained in-flight cleanup`
- [x] `releaseInFlight elects only one waiter to restart fetch`
- [x] `serve deadline returns before uncooperative work finishes`
- [x] `timed out serve retains in-flight until cleanup releases the cache key`
- [x] `sequential serve deadline timeouts on one key do not stack in-flight work`
- [x] `clamped serve request timeout rejects oversized finite values`
- [x] `same key waiter registered before fetch completes receives response`
- [x] `cleanup releases retained key when cooperative work exits early`
- [x] Live `codexbar serve` + `curl /usage` bounded-response transcript (above)
- [x] `make check`
